title: Abbas tu jeeta rahe
body:
tu haram ki shaan hai tu haram ki jaan hai
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye zainab ki dua
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
tu hai sarwar ka asa
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
tu sukoon e dil hai jaane fatema ke waaste
har ghadi dhaaras hai tu shaahe huda ke waaste
tujhko maanga hai ali ne karbala ke waaste
ay alamdar e wafa
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri ghairat aasman hai naazishe ummul baneen
karbala mein faqr se kehta hai zainab ka yaqeen
mutmain sab bibiyan hai dekh kar parda nasheen
kaun cheenega rida
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk bahrne ke liye qaime se nikla jis ghadi
baazuon ko choom kar bhai ke zainab ro padi
ghamzada zainab ke dil ki aur bechaini badi
kaampte dil ne kaha
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
de ke ghazi ko alam kehte thay ye shaahe zaman
tere hone se badi dhaaras hai jaan e panjetan
apni chadar ka muhafiz tujhko kehti hai behan
tu hai sarmeina mera
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis khadar ehsaas tha ahle haram ki pyaas ka
kat gaye baazu to mashkeeze ko daaton mein liya
isko kehte hai itaa'at isko kehte hai wafa
goonjti thi ye sada
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
quwwat e baazu hai tu sher e khuda ke laal ka
yunhi lehrata rahe parcham tere iqbal ka
aasra hai karbala mein tashnalab atfaal ka
ay sakina ke chacha
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
jang karne ke liye kab haath mein talwaar li
sar jhuka kar bhai se daad e wafa har baar li
nehr se qaime hataye apni khwahish maar li
keh rahi hai fatema
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
faqr se takti hai zainab baap ki tasveer ko
hai bahot tujh par bharosa shaah ki hamsheer ko
kaun jakdega rasan mein zainab e dilgeer ko
hamsar e sher e khuda
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sune ummul baneen ne karbala ke waqiyaat
aamir o akhtar tasavvur mein thay bas ghazi ke haath
sehn e khaana mein bana kar chaar qabrein ek saath
ek pa ashkon se likha
abbas tu jeeta rahe abbas tu jeeta rahe
hai ye zainab ki dua...
author: Akhtar Sirsvi
